snippet.title: House Flipper Remastered Collection - OFFICIAL Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
The date is set! Starting from June 4th, rediscover the house renovation classic, featuring a complete visual overhaul with new lighting, textures, a modernized UI, and smoother mechanics. 🔥 
House Flipper Remastered Collection bundles all previous DLCs and adds highly-requested community features like an enhanced Photomode, more items and brand new jobs. Prepare for the ultimate flipping experience!

Remember to add the collection to your Wishlist on Steam so you won't miss any news about the release! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710840/House_Flipper_Remastered_Collection/
